name: Hot Input
description: Drive near its top: the input pair is pushed deep into its curve, thick and buzzing on the second and third harmonics, and the output turned down to match.

name: Open Warmth
description: Wide open, the input pair driven a little: nothing taken away, a touch of second harmonic and the couplings' gentle low cut. For a synth or a drum bus that wants the ladder's colour without its filtering.

name: Round Bass
description: Cutoff low, no emphasis: the four poles roll off the top of a bass line at 24 dB an octave and leave its body.

name: Singing Corner
description: Emphasis at the top: the ladder sings a sine at its corner once something starts it, and a note through it is pulled and beaten against. Turn the cutoff to play it.

name: Squelch
description: Emphasis high and cutoff in the low middle: the corner peaks hard and the bass thins under it, the vowel of a plucked monosynth bass. Move the cutoff for the sweep.

name: Telephone Dark
description: Cutoff near the bottom of its travel: only the lows pass, as from a room away.

name: Thin Brass
description: The corner in the upper middle with moderate emphasis: the bass thinned a little and a peak near 500 Hz, a brassy edge for a saw.

name: Vocal Peak
description: The corner a little above 1 kHz, emphasis at six: a narrow peak that gives a lead line a voice.
